messages:
Anya V: quick check-in — ran the small-batch gating + kvcache prefetch flag on canary tonight, seeing unexpected TTFT bump on routes with short prompts.
Joel K: linked the run? can you paste the dashboard + qual traces?
Anya V: dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/abc123/prefetch-batcher?orgId=1 (will be public to infra team)
Anya V: tl;dr: median token.ttft_ms rose from ~18ms -> ~34ms for 1-2 token responses, decode time unchanged. kernel.exec_ms flat.
Marco P: hmm kernel.exec flat suggests the exec path isn't slower. could be prequeue/selector or kvcache prefetch blocking the first token.
Sam H: do we have per-stage breakdown? prequeue, kernel-chooser, kvcache-prefetch, kernel-queue, kernel-exec, postprocess?
Anya V: yes, added new instrumentation for token-level stages in this run. metrics emitted: token.ttft_ms, token.decode_ms, token.stage_prequeue_ms, token.stage_selector_ms, token.stage_kvcache_prefetch_ms, token.stage_kernel_queue_ms, token.stage_kernel_exec_ms, token.stage_post_ms
Joel K: can you paste a flame/log sample?
Anya V: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T22:03:12Z] request id=rq_9a3 kernel_choice=matmul_opt batch_id=14 prompt_len=1
stage prequeue 1.2ms
stage selector 0.5ms
stage kvcache_prefetch 11.8ms <-- heavy
stage kernel_queue 2.9ms
stage kernel_exec 15.0ms
first_token_emit latency 31.4ms
```
Marco P: that kvcache_prefetch 11.8ms lines up. Did prefetch run synchronously for small batches?
Anya V: yes, gating logic currently runs a blocking prefetch when model variant reports cold kvcache for prefix. We thought it was cheap but now it's non-trivial for short requests.
Sam H: could we make prefetch async or only for >N tokens? or prefer cached-ttl heuristics?
Joel K: also check batching heuristics: for small batches we break microbatch alignment and the selector may pick a microkernel that triggers slower prefetch path. Need to correlate kernel_choice with prefetch time.
Anya V: correlation table shows matmul_opt + prefetch_enabled = 82% of regressions. single-token routes disproportionately affected.
perf-bot: perf-alert: token.ttft_ms.p50 on route "quick-reply" increased 90% between 1999498000 and 1999501200. Alert channel: #eng-runtime.
Marco P: actionable options: (1) make kvcache prefetch async and emit early (2) add small-batch fast-path that skips prefetch and accepts slightly higher subsequent decode cost (3) change selector to prefer kernel variants with warm-kv fast path for <3 token inputs.
Sam H: I like (1) as low-risk: start with background prefetch and a 5ms budget; if it doesn't finish we still continue rendering. Add a metric: token.kvcache_prefetch_blocking_ms vs token.kvcache_prefetch_async_ms.
Joel K: also add dashboard panels showing per-route take-rate for prefetch and delta on token.ttft_ms. we need a per-route KPI: p50_ttft_when_prefetch / p50_ttft_when_no_prefetch.
Anya V: I'll push a small change to make prefetch background and add metrics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523 (WIP)
Anya V: noted we should also run the A/B across dedicated hardware where kernel exec latency differs — prefetch cost might be proportionally smaller on higher-end GPUs.
Marco P: good call. schedule canary across dedicated pool and hosted. add experiment tag `exp=prefetch_async_v1`.
Sam H: can someone add a transient dashboard that tracks: token.kvcache_prefetch_blocking_ms p50/p95, token.ttft_ms p50/p95 partitioned by prompt_length=1/2/3, kernel_choice, and route? I can template the panels if you want.
Anya V: yes please, Sam. Also instrument and emit a trace-span on the selector decision path so we can see handoff time.
Joel K: we should avoid inflating cardinality too much. use route hash + kernel_choice as tags; avoid full prompt text.
Anya V: ack. I'll iterate on PR and start the canary tomorrow morning.
Marco P: thanks. Next check-in after canary runs — ping in this thread with the canary id. :thumbsup:
